mapper.select: SELECT t.project_level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT pbi.project_level, pbi.project_id, pu.user_id FROM project_base_info pbi INNER JOIN project_user pu ON pbi.project_id = pu.project_id WHERE pu.user_id = #{userId} AND pu.project_user_role <> 6 ) t GROUP BY t.project_level

SELECT t.project_level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT pbi.project_level, pbi.project_id, pu.user_id FROM project_base_info pbi INNER JOIN project_user pu ON pbi.project_id = pu.project_id WHERE CURRENT_DATE >= pbi.project_establish_time AND CURRENT_DATE <= pbi.project_scheduled_completion_time AND pu.project_user_role <> 6 AND pu.user_id = #{userId} ) t GROUP BY t.project_level
